title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 011
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute flower variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Tulip blossom on a stem with one leaf and a curved ground line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tulip style flower rather than a flat petal rosette.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for circular petal flowers when the stem and ground line are visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a closed tulip shaped blossom on a stem instead of a petal wheel.

items.depicts_observation: Flower outline with six petal loops around a round center ring
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple front facing flower made from evenly spaced petals.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for stemmed or spiral blossoms when the visible form is a six petal rosette.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the cleanest petal flower with a centered round core and no stem.

items.depicts_observation: Flower outline with four rounded petal loops around a small center ring
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a flower made from four overlapping rounded petal loops.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the six petal daisy or spiral blossom when the flower has four looping petals.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses four large looping petals instead of many petals or a stemmed bloom.

items.depicts_observation: Three petal tulip blossom on a stem with two side leaves
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a stemmed flower with open side leaves and a three petal crown.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the simpler tulip icon when the extra side leaves need to stay visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot differs from flower by adding broader side leaves and a more open petal shape.

items.depicts_observation: Flower outline with many rounded petal loops around a small center dot
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the most ornate rounded blossom in this flower family.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for simpler four or six petal flowers when the many swirling petals matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot packs many rounded petals into a spiral flower instead of a few large petals.
